source_pull_requests.title: feat: simplify proxy setup, bilingual UI and encrypted profile storage

release_notes.en-US:
Changes from PR #92: simplify proxy setup, bilingual UI and encrypted profile storage.

• Compact English/Simplified Chinese interfaces with light and dark themes, profile search and quicker setup.
• Automatic draft checks preview the exit IP, approximate location and timezone through the entered proxy without changing existing browsing. Checks contact ipwho.is before Save or enable.
• Save stages edits; Save and enable saves and activates the visible form. Saved and applied configurations stay separate.
• Optional local master-password vault keeps profiles and credentials encrypted across Firefox restarts, with encrypted backup and empty-install restore. Unlock again after a full restart; the master password cannot be reset.
• New proxies default to proxy-only WebRTC, automatic identity and SOCKS proxy DNS. Existing choices are preserved and remain editable.
• Online maps remember the user's loading preference while rechecking routing, credentials and consent for each visible opening.

Firefox desktop 140+; bring your own proxy. No anonymity or browser-wide kill-switch guarantee. Protected Firefox requests remain outside complete extension control, and proxy servers must reject anonymous access when account identity matters.
release_notes.zh-CN:
来自 PR #92：简化代理配置、双语界面与加密配置存储。

• 紧凑英文／简体中文界面，支持浅色／深色主题、配置搜索与快速添加。
• 自动通过输入的草稿代理预览出口 IP、大致位置和时区，不改变已有浏览线路；保存或启用前会请求 ipwho.is。
• “保存”保留编辑；“保存并启用”保存并应用当前表单。已保存与已应用配置保持独立。
• 可选本地主密码保险库让配置与凭据跨 Firefox 重启加密保存，支持加密备份及空白安装恢复。完整重启后需重新解锁，主密码无法重置。
• 新代理默认采用仅代理 WebRTC、自动身份及 SOCKS 代理 DNS；已有选择保留，仍可手动调整。
• 在线地图记住用户的加载偏好，每次打开可见地图仍检查当前线路、凭据与许可。

需要 Firefox 桌面版 140 或更新版本，请自备代理。不保证匿名，也不是浏览器级万能断网开关。Firefox 受保护请求仍存在控制边界；需要确保账户身份时，代理服务器必须拒绝匿名访问。
